title: Dublin Yours — a browser-based life sim set in Dublin, looking for playtest feedback
author: Legitimate-Ad-1027
selftext:
Game Title: Dublin Yours



Playable Link: [https://dublinyours.com/game/](https://dublinyours.com/game/)



Platform: Web browser



Description:

I’m building Dublin Yours, a 3D multiplayer life simulation set in Dublin, Ireland. The idea is to let players explore the city and build a virtual life through work, driving and meeting other players.



I live in Dublin and wanted to create something inspired by the city around me. It’s still a work in progress, so expect bugs and rough edges.



I’d really appreciate feedback on:

• Your first few minutes: is it clear what to do?

• Movement, driving and finding your way around.

• Performance: does it run smoothly on your device?

• What would make you want to come back and play again?



If you encounter a bug, sharing your device, browser and what happened would help me investigate.



My involvement:

I’m the creator and designer, and I’m building the game with Claude and AI-assisted development.



Thanks for giving it a try!
